abstract: Assesses non-mandatory corporate environmental and emissions ratings
system_message:
You are the Corporate environmental standards evaluator (SUST). Your responsibility is to evaluate and record non-mandatory corporate environmental and emissions ratings, including fleet electrification metrics and depot renewable energy utilization across candidate distribution partners.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Assesses non-mandatory corporate environmental and emissions ratings（ECO）
information_points.content:
SUST-ECO-05L：According to corporate environmental disclosures across its total corporate vehicle asset register, Apex BioLogistics Consortium maintains an electric fleet adoption rate of 35%, representing the percentage of its total motorized fleet powered by full battery electric drivetrains.
SUST-ECO-7IF：Based on corporate environmental disclosures for its total corporate vehicle asset register, Vanguard LifeSciences Transport demonstrates an electric fleet adoption rate of 35% of its total motorized fleet powered by full battery electric drivetrains.
SUST-ECO-T2S：Corporate environmental disclosures for ThermaGuard Global Freight indicate an electric fleet adoption rate of 55% across its total corporate vehicle asset register, measured as the percentage of the total motorized fleet powered by full battery electric drivetrains.

information_points.title: Depot renewable energy share（SOLAR）
information_points.content:
SUST-SOLAR-LNM：Energy management utility audits across candidate distribution hubs and cross-docks show that Apex BioLogistics Consortium achieves an on-site solar generation proportion of 55% of annual warehouse electrical load offset by solar arrays.
SUST-SOLAR-GEG：Energy management utility audits for ThermaGuard Global Freight indicate an on-site solar generation proportion of 40% of annual warehouse electrical load offset by solar arrays across candidate distribution hubs and cross-docks.
SUST-SOLAR-7IU：Energy management utility audits across candidate distribution hubs and cross-docks confirm that Vanguard LifeSciences Transport maintains an on-site solar generation proportion of 25% of annual warehouse electrical load offset by solar arrays.
